capabilities: keep the text cursor vertically centered while editing
save and restore scroll and cursor positions per file
disable code wrapping and enable horizontal scrolling for code and inline MathJax
set maximum line length and add scroll buttons and vim-like reading-mode keybinds
extras: All features are optional and individually configurable; the README lists similar plugins (Obsidian Scroll Speed, Scroll Offset, Scroll Control, Typewriter Mode, Typewriter Scroll) but does not position itself as a replacement for any of them.
problem: Obsidian's default scrolling behavior lacks typewriter-style cursor centering, position memory, horizontal scrolling for long code or formulas, and navigation shortcuts.
summary: Scrolling enhancement plugin that keeps the cursor centered, restores scroll positions, and adds horizontal scrolling, scrollbar controls and reading-mode keybinds.
